text:
ada: FYI saw a small set of billing diffs from resumed streams — duplicate provisional ledger rows on resume.
sam: any sample?
ada: s_res_8b1f. Quick query showed two provisional rows within 2-4s for same session.
``sql
select session_id, count(*) from token_ledger where route='/v1/streams/resume' and event_ts > '2025-09-10' group by session_id having count(*)>1;
```
nina: runtime traces: shard rebalance -> replica A GC'd snapshot, client retried aggressively hitting replica B which accepted a provisional. A later wrote confirm. We end up with a stray provisional that never reconciles.
sam: two-prong fix: short-term client backoff + server returns 409 when coordinator reports snapshot_missing; medium-term ledger key versioning.
ada: product wants a 24h low-risk patch — what's feasible?
sam: implement client jitter + exponential backoff and teach resume to treat 409 as retryable with backoff. Server: if snapshot_missing, return 409 with body {retry_after_ms}. Add console alert for resume-409 spikes.
nina: add cheap server-side check: consult in-memory latest_confirm_seq for session; if incoming provisional_seq <= latest_confirm_seq, reject. No schema change needed and fast.
ada: billing-bot: preliminary reconcile found 47 affected sessions, ~1.1k tokens potential miscount. Ops-bot: created alert ENG-RESUME-409-SPIKE threshold 0.2% over 5m.
sam: deploy plan: patch client lib + server quick-check -> canary (eu-west) 12h -> ramp. PR will include unit tests simulating duplicate provisional writes.
nina: medium-term: ledger_key := session_id + '|' + coord_version + '|' + provisional_nonce; readers treat missing coord_version as '0'; streaming backfill job to rekey historical rows.
ada: owners assigned: nina (runtime coord), sam (client + canary), ada (console/billing). Timeline: short-term patch deploy in 24h, canary 12-24h, backfill spec in 2d.
ops-bot: scheduled canary deploy window: 02:00-14:00 UTC, tag stream-runtime/patch-20250910-canary.
billing-bot: queued backfill job bf-20250910-01; will report completion delta.
ada: I'll open ENG ticket (P2) with runbook and rollback criteria. Drop PR links and canary metrics here once ready.
